about: Word root builder (docs/anp-spec.md section 8.7). parts: prefixes, roots and suffixes with their real meaning and source language. terms: each term split into segments; a segment is [text, partId] or [text] for a linking vowel or ending that carries no meaning of its own. A term is tagged with the topic that teaches it and, when the map has one, the concept whose glossary entry it links to. A part is offered once any term that uses it is. Scored item ids: word-roots:<term>:decode and word-roots:<term>:build. Validator: scripts/lib/anp-tool-checks/word-roots.mjs.
